issue: QQ login window works after QR scan but OneBot channel remains disconnected
reproducedCause: Overlong Android host socket paths are relocated by PRoot. Direct connect can succeed while directory enumeration omits the socket. SnowLuma discovers pipes using directory enumeration, so it never detects the channel.
fix: Use the short private /manager/sl-ipc directory in QQ and SnowLuma; startup preflight requires socket bind AND directory enumeration to succeed.
